text:
sam: quick readout from a week's bench on nova14b and harmonia12b across summarization and long extractive QA. need a short GTN-ready recommendation for routing + canary strategy.

anya: can you paste the topline numbers?

sam: sure, pasted a condensed table below (aggregate across our 6 priority slices):
```
model      | quant  | EM/RougeL | p95_ms | cost/query($)
14b fp16   | fp16   | 74.8 / 56.2 | 520   | 0.0180
14b int8   | int8   | 74.1 / 55.8 | 380   | 0.0065
14b int4   | int4   | 72.0 / 53.4 | 290   | 0.0032
12b fp16   | fp16   | 71.0 / 52.0 | 400   | 0.0130
12b int4   | int4   | 69.5 / 50.5 | 240   | 0.0040
```
Notes: int8 is ~0.7 RougeL/EM drop vs fp16 (minor); int4 shows larger degradation on long-horizon multi-hop and few-shot summarization. latency gains are material (p95 down ~30-45% int8, ~45-60% int4). batching+kv-cache changes effective cost a lot.

lee: how much does KV hit change numbers?

sam: with a warm prefix cache (70% hit) effective cost/query drops ~35% vs cold; with 85% hit it's ~50% lower. cold start penalty adds ~60-90ms to p95 and ~25-40% to cost/query.

rachel: ok product wants a simple guardrail: keep customer-facing quality within X of baseline and hit cost target Y. what's a crisp routing rule we can hand over?

sam: proposal (short): route short summarization and chat (<100 tokens) to 12b-int4; route mid-length QA (100-400 tokens) to 14b-int8; route long or multi-hop (>400 tokens) to 14b-int8 with fp16 fallback if confidence signals fail.

anya: thresholds for autopromote vs manual review?

sam: recommend: autopromote allowed when (1) effective cost reduction >=35% vs current fp16 baseline (post-kv), (2) avg per-slice RougeL/EM drop <=0.8 points for non-critical slices and <=0.5 for critical slices, (3) hallucination increase <=2%. otherwise route requires SE sign-off.

lee: canary cadence?

sam: canary plan: 1% traffic for 6h -> 5% for 18h -> 20% for 48h (total ~72h). automatic rollback triggers: any critical slice RougeL/EM drop >1.2, hallucination rate up >3pp, or p95 latency regresses >25% vs expected.

ops-bot: created monitors: `rouge_drop_alert`, `halluc_rate_alert`, `p95_latency_guard`. placing alerts in #eng-ml and adding GTN tag `nova-14b-quant-canary`.

rachel: fallback behavior? dynamic or static?

sam: dynamic: if model confidence < threshold OR reranker score drops below slice baseline, route that request to fp16 fallback (same model family) for that session. log and surface to caller-level scorecard for rollback decisions.

anya: one-line for GTN/product to explain tradeoff?

rachel: "12b-int4 for very short summarization cuts cost ~70% with small quality loss; 14b-int8 is the middle-ground for long-form QA giving most of fp16 recall at ~60% lower cost."

sam: operational note: run a 24h synthetic drive with realistic KV hit distribution before the 1% canary to validate cost model and tune min_kv_hit. i'll schedule it.

ops-bot: synthetic run scheduled (24h) and health probe configured to post results into the handoff doc thread. will tag @rachel when complete.

lee: please add these flags into routing config: `autopromote_cost_cut`, `max_slice_quality_drop`, `canary_steps`, `fallback_confidence_cutoff`. GTN UI should show recommended defaults.

rachel: I'll draft the GTN handoff blurb and include the one-liner + the canary plan. tag me when the synthetic run finishes.

sam: will do and tag @rachel. thanks all :thumbsup:
